subject: Renewal + Capacity plan: staged migration 16→32 GPUs (OrbitAI)
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbitai.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.nguyen@orbitai.com, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — looking to double capacity for Q3

Evelyn,

Our renewal is coming up in May and we want to discuss moving from our current 16-GPU reserved pool to 32 GPUs. Over the last quarter we saw a mix of prod spikes and batch jobs that pushed latency during peak windows. We liked Redwood's available guidance on batching and KV cache but need a plan that minimizes rollout risk.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood provide a staged migration plan so we don't hit a hard cutover?
- Updated per-hour reserved pricing for 32 GPUs and any step-up discounts during the renewal term.
- A throughput/latency guardrail (SLA or target) for peak windows and a rollback path.

Tom (CC) is our infra lead and procurement will handle contracts. Can we book 30 minutes this week?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lim
Head of ML Ops, OrbitAI

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbitai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — looking to double capacity for Q3

Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. Happy to run through a proposal. Short answers up front: yes to staged migration, yes to a defined throughput guardrail, and we can present a revised per-hour reserved rate that includes a step-up discount schedule tied to committed term.

Proposed next steps (if that works for you):
1) 30-min sync Thurs 3/23 11:00am PT — cover migration phases, rollback, and SLA targets.
2) We will send a draft SOW + a 2-option ratecard by Friday: (A) flat 32-GPU reserved rate; (B) staged step-up: 50% capacity for month 1, 100% month 2, with blended per-hour pricing.
3) Procurement: we will include a short-term termination clause for the first 60 days of the step-up window to protect against unforeseen throughput degradation.

I've attached a playbook and initial ratecard draft. Marcus will outline runbook/CS onboarding, Aditya will follow up on commercials, and Dev will pre-check any contract language needs.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Growth — Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbitai.com>, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — looking to double capacity for Q3

Thanks for the sync earlier. Key commercial options we discussed are summarized below (see attached ratecard excel for per-hour math):

Option 1 — Immediate 32 GPU commit, 12 month term
- Reserved per-GPU per-hour: $X.XX (net)
- Volume discount: 5% for 12-month prepay
- Throughput target: 95th pct tokens/sec baseline; automatic burst to shared pool up to 10%

Option 2 — Staged migration (recommended)
- Month 0–1: ramp to 50% (8 GPUs live) at blended rate A
- Month 2: scale to 100% (32 GPUs) at blended rate B
- Staged discount applied during months 0–2 to reduce transition cost
- 60-day guarded rollback window (both sides can initiate) with pre-agreed performance checklist

We can also include a 90-day "quality holdback" where 10% of the incremental fees are tied to meeting agreed MLOps runbook SLAs (latency & throughput). That helps align incentives while you validate the new capacity.

Let me know which option OrbitAI prefers and I will issue an updated quote and SOW.

- Aditya

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@orbitai.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbitai.com>, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — looking to double capacity for Q3

Evelyn/Aditya — appreciate the clear options. A few clarifying questions from our infra/finance side:
- Can you define the exact throughput metric for the SLA? We run both low-latency inference and large batch jobs; we need separation of guarantees or priority tiers.
- For staged migration, can you guarantee no more than a 5% increase in p95 latency during the month-1 ramp? If not guaranteed, we need a credit schedule.
- Is the rollback path automated (instant re-route) or manual with a configuration window? We prefer an automated failback for the first 72 hours of full cutover.

Procurement: please send the SOW and the commercial quote to procurement@orbitai.com. We need the contract by 4/6 to meet internal approval cycles.

Thanks,
Tom
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, OrbitAI

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbitai.com>, tom.nguyen@orbitai.com, procurement@orbitai.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — looking to double capacity for Q3

Team — quick update and next steps based on your asks.

1) SLA definition and credits: we propose two measurable metrics — (A) p95 inference latency per model class and (B) sustained tokens/sec across the reserved pool during configured peak windows. If p95 exceeds the agreed baseline by >5% in a billing cycle, OrbitAI receives a 7% credit on incremental GPU-hours for that cycle. Full SLA terms to be in SOW.

2) Rollback behavior: staged migration will use automatic traffic split + instant failback orchestration for the first 72 hours after full cutover. We will include automated runbook steps (Marcus) and an ops playbook PDF (attached).

3) Commercials: attached is the final ratecard (Redwood_Ratecard_16to32_v2.xlsx) with per-hour math for both options and a blended-step pricing table for the staged migration. Option 2 (staged) includes a 6% blended discount across the first 90 days and the 10% quality holdback that triggers after successful verification.

4) Timeline: we will send the SOW by 4/4. If OrbitAI signs the DocuSign by 4/10 we can schedule the ramp to start 4/22 and be at full 32-GPU capacity by 5/22. Procurement: please review the attached SOW draft and the DocuSign link in the HubSpot deal.

If that plan looks good I'll have Dev pre-clear a short contract clause for the 60-day termination right and Marcus will share onboarding dates.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Growth — Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Redwood_Ratecard_16to32_v2.xlsx, staged-migration-playbook.pdf, OrbitAI_SOW-drafts.zip
